Name: HomePage

Home

The first screen to appear as a landing page after pressing the login button is 'Home' Summary page. It has three different summary grids (see image).

  • Summary grid [1] Faurecia Invoices by State (see image) provides a quick analysis of invoices in different states and their corresponding amount's total.
  • Summary grid [2] Cash Forecast (see image) provides a summary of invoice's cash forecast on which a discount offer has been proposed, their corresponding quantity, and face value (EUR).
